raw_glosses: (transitive) To end up; to set on end.
glosses: To end up; to set on end.

examples.text: When he upended the bottle of water over his sleeping sister, the lid popped off and surprised them both.
upend the box and empty the contents

Venezuela, who introduced the exciting 17-year-old Samuel Sosa late on, pressed forward and eventually carved out a golden opportunity to level. examples.text: By the middle of March 2020, the COVID-19 pandemic upended normal life for virtually all Americans.
